items.content_html: ProWeather is a lightweight weather web app with vanilla JavaScript and optional Flask backend. It shows current weather, 7-day forecast, local time, temperature chart, and tips for wind, rain, and temperature. Users can search by city, use geolocation, switch units, and view recent searches easily.
